Strategy And Preparedness of the State for 100% Audit of RLB
Accounts from 2023-2024 onwards
 A special drive has been taken by E.L.A., West Bengal for completion of Audit of 15th
F.C. Fund of PRI bodies within the stipulated time.
 Approximate date of completion is May’2023.
 Till date approx. 2000 Gram Panchayats has been scheduled for audit.
 A Joint Advisory note has been circulated throughout the state in this regard.
Department of Panchayats & Rural Developement, W.B.

STATUTORY AUDIT (External Audit)
Conducted by ELA
The accounts of the funds of Gram Panchayats, Panchayat Samitis and Zilla Parishads shall be
examined and audited by the Auditor appointed by the State Government under sub-section (1) of the
Section 186 of the W.B. Panchayat Act ,at least once a year.

Issued faces in eGramSwaraj and Audit Online
Section :- Audit Online
Delay in mapping of PRI functionaries in the Audit Online platform consequently, it was not possible
for the respective Audit Parties to send entry meeting to the concerned units on time due to non-
acceptance
 delay in acceptance of entry meeting, Audit Parties were unable to record audit observation and
generate Audit Report.
Checking of draft Audit Reports at the HQ are normally carried out at three levels (e.g. first at the
level of Auditor/ Sr. Auditor, second at the level of Assistant Audit Officer and finally at the level of Sr.
Audit Officer). Due to limitation of the Audit Online software, here checking is constrained to be
carried out at the final level only. In absence of first two level of checking, it takes time at the level of
Sr. Audit Officers to exercise all types of checks.
The Audit Report on the Accounts of PRI contains the comments on the summary of Accounts, the
Observations and Audit Opinion. The Audit Online application is not designed to prepare a
consolidated report incorporating all three parts in one go. Rather, the Report is to be generated by
preparing several pdf files and uploading those in the system which is not only cumbersome and time
consuming, causing considerable delay.
Department of Panchayats & Rural Developement, W.B.

Issued faces in eGramSwaraj and Audit Online
Section :- Audit Online
There is no clear role segregation between generator of Draft Report and Approver in Audit Online
platform, unlike the existing manual practice of this office. Even if there is any, the ELA, the Approver,
must generate report, rather than approving/ modifying the same. This will only lead to unnecessary
delay as the ELA cannot be expected to generate the report after adding each component of the Report
as stated above on each unit audited. Instead, the draft report must be generated by Editing Officer and
send to the approver via Audition line application with the privilege to either modify or approve it.
However, the same is missing in the Audit Online application system.
After generation of Audit Report using Audit Online platform, the system does not allow the Sr. Audit
Officer to make any modification in the Audit Report which are suggested by the ELA.
Department of Panchayats & Rural Developement, W.B.

Issued faces in eGramSwaraj and Audit Online
Section :- Accounts
 Receipt component should be fixed as per Allotment while doing receive entry. And auto
receipt entry for interest
 Journal entry for wrong deduction entry.
 Option for rectification of manual receipt entry and auto receipt entry in state login.
Section :- Planning & Progressing
 In case of convergence scheme it is very difficult to show it through a single activity. It creates
problem while making payment. If all the payment of convergence scheme can be made
through this portal, it can be overcome.
 There should be an option for showing Tender process. In Admin approval section it can be
incorporated, like uploading of Tender notice & date, selection of L1, amount of tender,
Scheme contingency amount, AMC amount etc.
Department of Panchayats & Rural Developement, W.B.

Issued faces in eGramSwaraj and Audit Online
Section:- Reporting
• Plan year wise Receive, Expenditure and Unspent balance detail report.
• Geo tag image report for all the Tiers.
• Agency wise deduction report
• Activity Analysis Report should be corrected and it is required for all the tiers.
• Yearly cashbook report.
• Due to slow PFMS response in payment rejection, wrong report is showing.
• No report of 15th FC in PFMS.
Department of Panchayats & Rural Developement, W.B.
